list.name: location
list.label: Location
list.query: SELECT CASE location WHEN 'LAN' THEN 'On site (LAN)' ELSE 'Remote (online)' END AS __text, location AS __value FROM streamer_v WHERE location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location ORDER BY location
list.definition: SELECT CASE location WHEN 'LAN' THEN 'On site (LAN)' ELSE 'Remote (online)' END AS __text, location AS __value FROM streamer_v WHERE location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location ORDER BY location

list.name: streamer
list.label: Streamer
list.query: SELECT display AS __text, twitch_id AS __value FROM streamer_v st WHERE coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY lower(display)
list.definition: SELECT display AS __text, twitch_id AS __value FROM streamer_v st WHERE coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY lower(display)

targets.rawSql: SELECT donation_total FROM snapshot ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT max(donation_total) - min(donation_total) FROM snapshot WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'

panels.title: Donations not tied to a streamer

targets.rawSql: SELECT sn.donation_total - sum(s.donation_total) FROM snapshot sn JOIN streamer_sample_v s USING (ts) WHERE NOT s.derived AND sn.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) GROUP BY sn.donation_total

panels.description: All donations that could not be tied to a streamer: the event total minus the sum of the streamer counters. This holds donations made by people without picking a streamer (the Streamlabs Charity team page without a member), the tickets of the concert on Thursday, all shop donations, and so on. The derived "mistermv (private counter)" row is left out of the streamer sum: since 01:08 UTC on Sept 5 it mirrors Domingo's counter, which is already counted once.

panels.title: MisterMV's private counter

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(donation_total), 0) FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE derived AND ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot)

panels.description: The part of mistermv's counter that mirrors Domingo's since 01:08 UTC on Sept 5: donations to Domingo credited to both. Shown as the "mistermv (private counter)" entry in the leaderboards and left out of "Donations not tied to a streamer".

panels.title: Viewers now

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(s.viewers), 0) FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND NOT st.derived AND s.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'

panels.description: Viewers of the streamers matching the Location and Streamer filters, at the latest sample.

panels.title: Peak viewers

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(max(v), 0) FROM (  SELECT s.ts, sum(s.viewers) AS v FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND NOT st.derived AND s.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'  GROUP BY s.ts) x

panels.description: Highest combined viewer count of the streamers matching the Location and Streamer filters, within the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT streamers_online AS "Online", streamers_total AS "Total" FROM snapshot ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Hours streamed

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(extract(epoch FROM least(nxt - ts, interval '5 minutes'))) / 3600, 0) FROM (  SELECT s.ts, s.online, lead(s.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY s.twitch_id ORDER BY s.ts) AS nxt  FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id)  WHERE NOT st.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' AND $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.twitch_id IN ($streamer)) x WHERE online AND nxt IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Total time live, summed over the streamers matching the Location and Streamer filters, within the selected time range. Each live sample counts until the next sample (capped at 5 minutes, so gaps in the data do not count).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, donation_total AS "Total" FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, viewers_total AS "Viewers" FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), sum(delta) AS "Donated" FROM (  SELECT ts, donation_total - lag(donation_total) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS delta  FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) d WHERE delta IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, streamers_online AS "Online" FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Donations not tied to a streamer, over time (total minus all streamers)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sn.ts AS time, sn.donation_total - sum(s.donation_total) FILTER (WHERE NOT s.derived) AS "Not tied to a streamer", coalesce(sum(s.donation_total) FILTER (WHERE s.derived), 0) AS "Mirrored (mistermv)" FROM snapshot sn JOIN streamer_sample_v s USING (ts) WHERE $__timeFilter(sn.ts) GROUP BY sn.ts, sn.donation_total ORDER BY 1

panels.description: All donations that could not be tied to a streamer: the event total minus the sum of the streamer counters. This holds donations made by people without picking a streamer (the Streamlabs Charity team page without a member), the tickets of the concert on Thursday, all shop donations, and so on. The derived "mistermv (private counter)" row is left out of the streamer sum: since 01:08 UTC on Sept 5 it mirrors Domingo's counter, which is already counted once.

panels.title: Donations not tied to a streamer, per interval (total gain minus streamer gains)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), sum(g) - sum(sg) AS "Not tied to a streamer" FROM (  SELECT ts, donation_total - lag(donation_total) OVER ( ORDER BY ts) AS g FROM snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) gl JOIN (  SELECT ts, sum(delta) AS sg FROM (    SELECT ts, donation_total - lag(donation_total) OVER (PARTITION BY twitch_id ORDER BY ts) AS delta FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE NOT derived AND $__timeFilter(ts)  ) x GROUP BY ts) st USING (ts) WHERE g IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: All donations that could not be tied to a streamer: the event total minus the sum of the streamer counters. This holds donations made by people without picking a streamer (the Streamlabs Charity team page without a member), the tickets of the concert on Thursday, all shop donations, and so on. The derived "mistermv (private counter)" row is left out of the streamer sum: since 01:08 UTC on Sept 5 it mirrors Domingo's counter, which is already counted once.

targets.rawSql: WITH top AS (SELECT game FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.online AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY game ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 8) SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN game IN (SELECT game FROM top) THEN game ELSE 'Other' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.online AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH top AS (SELECT game FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.online AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY game ORDER BY sum(viewers) DESC LIMIT 8) SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN game IN (SELECT game FROM top) THEN game ELSE 'Other' END AS metric, sum(viewers) AS value FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.online AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH h AS (  SELECT twitch_id, sum(extract(epoch FROM least(nxt - ts, interval '5 minutes'))) / 3600 AS hours FROM (    SELECT ts, twitch_id, online, lead(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY twitch_id ORDER BY ts) AS nxt    FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)  ) x WHERE online AND nxt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY twitch_id) , cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, donation_total, viewers, online FROM streamer_sample_v  WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot)) SELECT st.display AS "Streamer", cur.donation_total AS "Donations", cur.viewers AS "Viewers", coalesce(h.hours, 0) AS "Hours", st.login AS login FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN h USING (twitch_id) WHERE true AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY cur.donation_total DESC LIMIT 25

WITH h AS (  SELECT twitch_id, sum(extract(epoch FROM least(nxt - ts, interval '5 minutes'))) / 3600 AS hours FROM (    SELECT ts, twitch_id, online, lead(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY twitch_id ORDER BY ts) AS nxt    FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)  ) x WHERE online AND nxt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY twitch_id) , cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, donation_total, viewers, online FROM streamer_sample_v  WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot)) SELECT st.display AS "Streamer", cur.donation_total AS "Donations", cur.viewers AS "Viewers", coalesce(h.hours, 0) AS "Hours", st.login AS login FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN h USING (twitch_id) WHERE cur.online AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY cur.viewers DESC LIMIT 25

WITH h AS (  SELECT twitch_id, sum(extract(epoch FROM least(nxt - ts, interval '5 minutes'))) / 3600 AS hours FROM (    SELECT ts, twitch_id, online, lead(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY twitch_id ORDER BY ts) AS nxt    FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)  ) x WHERE online AND nxt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY twitch_id) , cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, donation_total, viewers, online FROM streamer_sample_v  WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot)) , g AS (  SELECT twitch_id, sum(delta) AS gained FROM (    SELECT ts, twitch_id, donation_total - lag(donation_total) OVER (PARTITION BY twitch_id ORDER BY ts) AS delta    FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)  ) d WHERE delta IS NOT NULL GROUP BY twitch_id) SELECT st.display AS "Streamer", g.gained AS "Gained", cur.donation_total AS "Donations", cur.viewers AS "Viewers", coalesce(h.hours, 0) AS "Hours", st.login AS login FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN h USING (twitch_id) JOIN g USING (twitch_id) WHERE true AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY g.gained DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top by hours streamed in selected range

targets.rawSql: WITH h AS (  SELECT twitch_id, sum(extract(epoch FROM least(nxt - ts, interval '5 minutes'))) / 3600 AS hours FROM (    SELECT ts, twitch_id, online, lead(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY twitch_id ORDER BY ts) AS nxt    FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)  ) x WHERE online AND nxt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY twitch_id) , cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, donation_total, viewers, online FROM streamer_sample_v  WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot)) SELECT st.display AS "Streamer", cur.donation_total AS "Donations", cur.viewers AS "Viewers", coalesce(h.hours, 0) AS "Hours", st.login AS login FROM cur JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN h USING (twitch_id) WHERE true AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY coalesce(h.hours, 0) DESC, cur.donation_total DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Donations of selected streamers

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(s.donation_total), 0) FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE s.ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND s.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND NOT s.derived AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$'

panels.description: Sum of the selected streamers' counters at the latest snapshot. The derived "mistermv (private counter)" entry is not real money and is left out even when selected.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.ts AS time, st.display AS metric, st.login AS login, s.donation_total AS value FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.ts AS time, st.display AS metric, st.login AS login, s.viewers AS value FROM streamer_sample_v s JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.twitch_id IN ($streamer) AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Donations gained per streamer per interval

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(d.ts, $__interval), st.display AS metric, st.login AS login, sum(d.delta) AS value FROM (  SELECT ts, twitch_id, donation_total - lag(donation_total) OVER (PARTITION BY twitch_id ORDER BY ts) AS delta  FROM streamer_sample_v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND twitch_id IN ($streamer)) d JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) WHERE d.delta IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (  SELECT twitch_id, ts, online, game, viewers FROM streamer_sample_v  WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM snapshot) AND twitch_id IN ($streamer)), changed AS (  SELECT c.twitch_id, max(s.ts) AS at FROM cur c JOIN streamer_sample_v s USING (twitch_id)  WHERE s.online <> c.online OR s.game IS DISTINCT FROM c.game GROUP BY c.twitch_id) SELECT st.display AS "Streamer", c.online AS "Online", c.game AS "Game", c.viewers AS "Viewers",        extract(epoch FROM c.ts - coalesce(ch.at, st.first_seen)) AS "Since", st.login AS login FROM cur c JOIN streamer_v st USING (twitch_id) LEFT JOIN changed ch USING (twitch_id) WHERE coalesce(st.location, '') ~ '^(${location:regex})$' ORDER BY c.online DESC, c.viewers DESC
